stem.text: Which feature of the disease cholera decreases the spread of the pathogen *Vibrio cholerae*?

A.text: Immunity to cholera after vaccination is short lived, lasting less than two years after vaccination in 50% of people.

B.text: Up to 98% of people infected with *Vibrio cholerae* are symptomless carriers.

C.text: Cholera rapidly kills up to 50% of people with symptoms if they are not treated.

D.text: Simple rehydration therapy successfully treats about 99% of people with symptoms of cholera.
